message: Waypoint Deck is a distinct field-computing project — not a Studio web app.

projects.title: Waypoint Deck
projects.tagline: Offline-first Linux field computer · maps, weather, radio, local knowledge.
projects.description: A local-first field computer for when connectivity is poor or gone. Direction includes offline maps/GPS, local AI, weather, radio/SDR, offline reference knowledge, sensors, and system awareness. Early-stage — do not assume these systems already ship.
